findings.text: The "Combined integration checkpoint" says the import and join repairs "still require their selected Nix checks". The new "Scoped Nix acceptance" section says those checks passed (exit 0). Fix: mark that paragraph as the state at that checkpoint, or change it to say that only hosted validation and combined acceptance remain.

"The remaining CI repair will use a separate follow-up PR" reads as a future plan. The new "Follow-up publication checkpoint" says draft PR 296 is already open. Fix: change it to "was published as draft PR 296", or label the paragraph as the state at the PR 295 merge.
